description: Worf joins DS9 as Klingon intervention in Cardassia shatters old alliances, while the Dominion threat grows and the station becomes a fault line between Klingon, Cardassian, Bajoran and Federation interests.

s04e01-02.description: A Klingon fleet arrives to confront a suspected Dominion threat, forcing Sisko to recruit Worf as the alliance with the Federation begins to fracture.

s04e03.description: An elderly Jake recounts the life he sacrificed trying to rescue his father after a Defiant accident pulls Sisko out of normal time.

s04e04.description: Bashir tries to free rogue Jem'Hadar from their drug dependency after a crash leaves him and O'Brien at odds over how far to help them.

s04e05.description: Kira and Dukat search for a missing prison transport and uncover a personal secret Dukat is desperate to control.

s04e06.description: Jadzia reunites with the new host of a symbiont once married to a former Dax host, challenging a powerful Trill taboo.

s04e07.description: Defiant is badly damaged inside a gas giant while defending a Karemma vessel from Jem'Hadar attack.

s04e08.description: Quark, Rom and Nog crash on Earth in 1947 and discover that their arrival has become humanity's famous Roswell incident.

s04e09.description: Worf, Dax and Kor find the legendary Sword of Kahless, only to discover that possessing it is more dangerous than searching for it.

s04e10.description: A transporter accident places the senior staff inside Bashir's spy holoprogram, where he must finish the adventure without killing its villains.

s04e11.description: A Changeling attack sends Sisko and Odo to Earth, where fear of Dominion infiltration begins reshaping Federation security.

s04e12.description: Sisko investigates the events behind martial law on Earth and discovers a threat arising from within Starfleet itself.

s04e13.description: Odo's feelings for Kira become impossible to ignore when First Minister Shakaar visits DS9 and their relationship grows closer.

s04e14.description: A disgraced Dukat escorts Kira to a conference and seizes an opportunity to strike back at Klingon raiders.

s04e15.description: Worf's dishonored brother Kurn arrives asking for a warrior's death while Kira investigates Klingon activity near Bajor.

s04e16.description: Rom organizes Quark's employees into a union, provoking a Ferengi labor confrontation that offends nearly every Rule of Acquisition.

s04e17.description: A Bajoran poet emerges from the wormhole claiming to be the true Emissary, leaving Sisko willing to surrender a role he never wanted.

s04e18.description: Worf faces extradition after destroying a civilian transport during battle, and Sisko must prove the engagement was manipulated.

s04e19.description: O'Brien returns from an alien prison after experiencing twenty virtual years of incarceration and struggles to separate memory from reality.

s04e20.description: The mirror Jennifer lures Jake across universes, forcing Sisko to help the Terran rebels complete a Defiant of their own.

s04e21.description: A mysterious visitor feeds on Jake's creativity while Lwaxana asks Odo to help her escape a marriage that would take away her child.

s04e22.description: Sisko investigates a suspected Maquis smuggler and discovers betrayal much closer to home than he expected.

s04e23.description: Defiant's crew reluctantly teams with Jem'Hadar soldiers to stop renegades from activating a dangerous Iconian gateway.

s04e24.description: Bashir tries to cure a population condemned by the Dominion to generations of suffering from a bioengineered disease.

s04e25.description: Quark sells the rights to his remains after a fatal diagnosis, while an accident forces Bashir to transfer the O'Briens' unborn child to Kira.

s04e26.description: Odo's body begins failing, forcing him back to the Founders for judgment as Federation-Klingon tensions worsen.
